reply_text:
I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message. The store is **Pine Crossing**.

That comes from Pree's own message in #central-team on 9 June. She wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had arrived at 7:10 the day before, and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he would check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem using the store login. Nothing later in the channel says it was fixed, and I mentioned that in the reply.

I only looked at the channel and the public files, which Pree can see too. None of those files mention Pine Crossing or give any other site detail for it, such as a site code.
